segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin say the lightweight, milky texture does not add shine and layers well without feeling like it works against their skin's own oil.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report strong hydration and a plumper, firmer feel, with several specifically noting it addressed dryness and dullness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-sensitive and combination-oily, describe the formula as balanced, non-greasy and gentle.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their own skin as sensitive, including combination-sensitive skin, consistently report no irritation, calling it gentle enough for reactive skin.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and firmer, plumper skin within one to three weeks of consistent use as a retinol alternative, though a few say they haven't yet seen a change in their wrinkles even while enjoying the hydration.
concerns.dehydration: The serum is overwhelmingly described as hydrating, leaving skin feeling plump, smooth and comfortable, including for reviewers with dry skin who specifically sought that effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes the serum soothed her redness while also helping with wrinkles.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers point to the ceramides in the formula as feeling like they support or repair their skin barrier, alongside the general hydration gains.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who describes her skin as acne-prone reports no new breakouts despite her skin usually reacting to new products.

aspects.libelle: Milky, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without stickiness
Black tea and bergamot scent, described as luxurious
Small dropper or pipette makes application awkward for some
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: [gifted by freshbeauty] The Fresh Black Tea Renewal Serum is really great for reducing fine lines and wrinkles by providing nourishment and hydration. I found it to be lightweight and firming for my skin.

extraits.titre: Very nice, gentle, and very lux
extraits.texte: This claims to visibly firm skin, smooth the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and even improve skin tone, and after many weeks I can confirm that I'm noticing subtle changes. The milky serum makes my skin feel very moisturized without being greasy. Definitely super smooth and my little lines are not gone but I feel like my wrinkles are just stalled. No progression which is great. Considering I have oily skin I can confidently keep using this without feeling like my skincare is working against my oils. The scent is very light. I noticed it initially but after repeated use I don't notice it at all. Entering my 40s has made me ramp up my skincare. This has been a nice luxury addition. This is something I plan on keeping in my routine. gifted by freshbeauty

In my early 30s. No interest in Botox or filler, was looking for something to help my deeper wrinkles in forehead, neck, and around my eyes and mouth. I also have oily / combination / acne prone skin. Received this as a gift and wow I am 14 days on use 2x a day, first thing to touch my skin, it layers well under other products, and my wrinkles look so much better!! Please do not touch this formula ever. It is PERFECT. it isn't irritating to my sensitive skin, no new breakouts, and it is more effective than any retinol I've ever used. And I have tried so many over the counter and Rx by doctors. A Fantastic product. Will buy forever.

I have been in need of a new serum and not just any serum, but one that actually does what it claims to do, which is Firm and smooth visible wrinkles. That is EXACTLY what this luxurious serum does and in a very short time! My skin leans combination-sensitive and this has been incredibly gentle while still being effective. My skin not only feels smoother immediately after each use, but I also noticed it looked more radiant and plumper too! The milky serum feels so lightweight and layers perfectly under my moisturizer and makeup. It absorbs right into my skin leaving it feeling so silky smooth and glowing! I absolutely love the light refreshing scent while applying it, I find it reminds me of the tea they serve while being pampered at the spa. It's quite enjoyable! complimentary from freshbeauty

I just adore this serum. It is very hydrating and makes my skin feel comfortable after cleansing. It takes away that dry and tight feeling. It also seems to be helping with my chin area in terms of firmness. The skin just has more bounce to it I think. It works under my makeup either way no pulling and doesn't make me feel tacky or greasy. I love the formula and how it's working for my skin. I do wish the packaging was a pump instead of a dropper but the serum itself is lovely. gifted by freshbeauty

extraits.titre: Black Tea Renewal Serum is Fantastic
extraits.texte: This is the first time I have used the Fresh Black Tea Serum and I am impressed. It goes on smoothly. I have sensitive skin and this serum is gentle, no harshness. My face is hydrated and I can feel that it is firming my skin. It is a great primer. Once again, Fresh has delivered a great product at a very reasonable price. I would highly recommend this serum.

A beautiful milky serum that smells like earl grey tea. What a delightful way to wake up and go to sleep. The packaging is hefty and I definitely feel like it is worth the money. It soothes my redness in addition to preventing wrinkles and adding hydration. I love the feel of it in my hand and the drops of it on my skin. complimentary from freshbeauty
